t: You're looking at Government Offices Great George Street, a large government office building on the north side of Parliament Square in Westminster. It fills the block between Horse Guards Road, King Charles Street, Parliament Street and Great George Street. The western end, on Horse Guards Road, is known as 1 Horse Guards Road, and the eastern end, on Parliament Street, is 100 Parliament Street. It was designed by Sir Henry Tanner, a prominent architect working for HM Office of Works.
